title: ChatGPT bet C$7,000 on a −249 favourite. It won 98-93. #AI #ChatGPT #NBA
description:
3 AIs (Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT) each got C$100,000 of pretend money to trade and bet with real prices, Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026.
ChatGPT bet C$7,000 on the Boston Celtics moneyline at −249 (Boston Celtics @ Toronto Raptors). Its reason, from the public ledger: "The high-risk sports book needs daily action, and Boston is the cleanest favorite I see without using a fragile parlay."
Final: Boston Celtics 98, Toronto Raptors 93. ChatGPT won C$2,811.
Check it yourself: transaction IDs X-AIS-025 and X-AIS-026 at PaperTrades.AI
Pretend money. Not betting or investment advice.
